note: Junie uses JetBrains AI service. Model availability depends on the team's JetBrains AI subscription tier. Higher tiers unlock stronger models. Per-agent model selection is limited.

tier-s.rationale: Junie's strongest available models. Required for architecture and complex implementation. If the team is on a lower tier, consider running tier-s agents outside Junie.

tier-a.rationale: Spec and validation require Pro-tier models. Do not attempt spec validation with lighter models — gate failures will cascade.

tier-b.rationale: Discovery and domain modeling work well with mid-tier models. Junie's 4o-mini equivalent is cost-effective for these phases.

tier-c.rationale: Lite agent tasks are small scope. Use the cheapest available model. If Junie does not expose model choice, accept the default and monitor cost.

cost_note: JetBrains AI pricing is subscription-based rather than per-token. Tier optimization matters less for Junie than for API-based runtimes. Focus on using the default model efficiently via JIT steering and skill lazy-loading.
